about: The pins of lean_mpas: upstream sources, toolchains and the Thompson tables. Read by tools/lean/config.py (load_lock).

mmm_physics.commit_why: the commit the annotated tag points to (git ls-remote: tag object 3ec5ac84809c445a196f01d84c4d2d1640b79776, ^{} a4baf7f3...); reference/mpas_src/src/core_atmosphere/physics/physics_mmm/PROVENANCE.txt records the same commit for the checkout. That folder is not a git clone of its own: git rev-parse there gives the enclosing MPAS-Model commit.

gsl_ugwp.commit_why: git ls-remote of the tag (a lightweight tag); not checked out locally, lean_mpas compiles nothing from it

gpu_why: cc: the card lean_mpas is tested on (cc 12.0); cc_min: older cards down to cc 7.0 are a warning (W_GPU_UNTESTED) and ./lean build compiles for their cc; nvhpc.min: a newer NVHPC than version is a warning (W_NVHPC_UNTESTED), an older one an error.

tables_why: sha256 and size from build/tables on the Mac; the Linux test machine's build/tables gives the same four sums and sizes (2026-10-24). Format checked against the reader in src/thompson.f90 (form='UNFORMATTED', no convert=, one read per record in this order) and against tools/dbl_big_endian.py, which parses these files with '<i' markers: every marker pair matches, the record counts equal the reads, and each record length is the array size x 8 bytes.
